limits: Actual complete file inventory/coverage is supplied by Root late entry, not inferred from directories; this CODE review does not certify future inventory completeness or read unknown leaves.
--verify-only validates declared physical transport SHA/size and mapping closure. Exact decompressed original SHA/size is checked by full restore; verify-only is not a full reconstruction receipt.
Source content SHA/size is checked during opaque streaming, before accepting the packaged artifact, not by an extra preliminary full source pass.
Deterministic gzip metadata is fixed; identical compression bytes across different zlib/runtime versions are not claimed. Restored original bytes remain exact.
No new tests were added: existing sealed A toy receipt was inspected as preparation evidence, and current pinned code compiled without execution.
scope: Independent bounded publication helper CODE/metadata review only; no package/source leaf/model/array/CP/Git/network access.
verified: False Root entry refuses before sourcebody access. True entry binds builder/self/restore CODE and exact Root scope; full explicit files and equality coverage contract, no tree traversal or embedded pointer follows.
Lexical v112/cache/pyc/current/held tokens and traversal rejected before artifact FS; absolute artifacts and package-relative canonical paths separately validated; all ancestor symlinks rejected.

Opaque entire original NPY/PT/etc bytes including headers read in1MiB chunks; no parse/decode/re-serialization. Expected source SHA/size checked as bytes stream into output; partial errors retained rather than accepted.
gzip.GzipFile filename empty/mtime0/level6; each completed gzip independently decompressed to expected original SHA/size before success.

Only compressed streams above Root single_file_limit are split into ordered64MiB parts; joined compressed SHA/size checked before deleting unsplit temporary. Every published raw/gzip transport leaf remains under declared limit.
Every physical manifest path has SHA/size; logical records preserve original SHA/size and ordered transport membership. Explicit raw4/canonical6/pairedCP2/log2/draw2 counts enforced.
Restorer uses only package MANIFEST and canonical relative physical paths; original_source_path_inert is never dereferenced. Every declared physicalfile belongs to exactly one logical artifact.
Full restore joins raw or gzip parts and hashes exact reconstructed whole bytes/header against original SHA/size. Fresh output/xb prevents overwrite; failure keeps partial receipt/no automatic retry.
No Git/network/model methods, NumPy/Torch imports or recursive FS enumeration in helper CODE; final Git/commit/push authority remains external Root.
